verdict.rationale: Every Supabase project is a managed, full Postgres database (with a free-tier allocation) that exposes instant auto-generated REST, GraphQL and Realtime APIs. The API-key model documents publishable keys for browser and mobile clients and secret keys for servers, and per-language client references (JS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Python, C#) plus generated types back SDK access. Community users confirm it is great for spinning up CRUD apps. Missing for 10: explicit first-party SDK read/write query examples in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of the server-side SDK usage specifically.
